label: Bible Study
prompt: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he _____ in mercy.
verse: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
note: Micah's name means 'Who is like the LORD?' — and his book closes by asking that very question.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: In him was life; and the life was the _____ of men.
verse: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
note: John's opening echoes Genesis: in Him was life, and that life became the light of men.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee _____ of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
note: The KJV calls them 'tables of stone' — what most of us learned to call tablets.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Though he were a Son, yet learned he _____ by the things which he suffered;
verse: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
note: A startling line: even the Son learned obedience in the school of suffering — the most humbling classroom there is.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: So we _____ in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verse: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
note: Half held spears while half built, from dawn till the stars appeared. Nehemiah's wall rose with trowels and swords.
